- Accuracy of the shift in LDL<sup>T</sup> decomposition.
- Correctness of the extraction and sorting of real eigenvalues.

To address the problem, I suggest focusing on enhancing the accuracy and correctness of eigenvalue computation and sorting within the `findEigenvalues` method.
